<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the total cost for all four of the family to go to the concert?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the total cost for all four of the family to go to the concert?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost} &= \text{Cost of} \  2  \ \text{adults} + \text{Cost of} \  2 \ \text{children } \\\\
                  &= 2 \times 45 + 2 \times 30.5 \\\\
                  &= 90 + 61 \\\\
                  &= \pounds 151 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 151$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

To see the mid-week show there is a special offer where a family ticket, for $2$ adults and $2$ children, costs only $\pounds 125$.

How much would this ticket save the family?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

<emptyline>
How much would this ticket save the family?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Savings} &= \text{Full price} - \text{Special offer}  \\\\
               &= 151 - 125 \\\\
               &= \pounds 26 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$17600$ people attended the concert.

Given that $40 \%$ of these were adults, how many people were adults?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$17600$ people attended the concert.
<emptyline>
Given that $40 \%$ of these were adults, how many people were adults?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Adults}   &= 40 \% \ \text{of} \ 17600  \\\\
                &= \dfrac {40} {100} \times 17600 \\\\
                &= \dfrac {40 \times 17600} {100} \\\\
                &= \dfrac {40 \times 176 \times 1\cancel{00}} {1\cancel{00}} \\\\
                &= {40 \times 176} \\\\
                &= 7040 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7040$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mrs Prince wishes to buy each member of her class a photo frame as a present.

There are $24$ pupils in her class and each photo frame costs $\pounds 3.75$.

Find the total cost of all $24$ frames. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mrs Prince wishes to buy each member of her class a photo frame as a present.
<emptyline>
There are $24$ pupils in her class and each photo frame costs $\pounds 3.75$.
<emptyline>
Find the total cost of all $24$ frames. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost}            &= \text{Count of pupils} \times \text{Cost per frame} \\\\\
                             &= 24 \times 3.75 \\\\
                             &= \pounds  90
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds  90$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$28450$ people attended a hockey match.

If $8217$ wore red and $11750$ wore blue, how many wore neither blue nor red?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$28450$ people attended a hockey match.
<emptyline>
If $8217$ wore red and $11750$ wore blue, how many wore neither blue nor red?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{People who wore neither blue nor red}     &= 28450 - (8217 + 11750) \\\\
                                                &= 28450 - 19967 \\\\
                                                &= 8483
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

$8483$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The Palladium can hold $2175$ spectators.

If $305$ of the seats are empty how many of the seats are taken?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The Palladium can hold $2175$ spectators.
<emptyline>
If $305$ of the seats are empty how many of the seats are taken?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Seats taken}     &= \text{Total seats} - \text{Empty seats} \\\\
                        &=  2175 - 305 \\\\
                        &=  1870
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1870$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bottle of fizzy pop holds $750 \ \text{ml}$.

How many $150 \ \text{ml}$ glasses can be filled from this bottle?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bottle of fizzy pop holds $750 \ \text{ml}$.
<emptyline>
How many $150 \ \text{ml}$ glasses can be filled from this bottle?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of glasses} &= \dfrac { \text{Total drink in the bottle} } { \text{Capacity of a glass} } \\\\
                        &= \dfrac { 750 } { 150 } \\\\
                        &= \dfrac { 5 \times 150 } { 150 } \\\\
                        &= \dfrac { 5 \times \cancel{150} } { \cancel{150} } \\\\
                        &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

                        &= \dfrac { 750 } { 150 } \\\\

Freya scored $16$ out of $20$ in her spelling test. Hannah scored $85 \%$ in her spelling test.

Who did better? You must explain your answer.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Freya scored $16$ out of $20$ in her spelling test. Hannah scored $85 \%$ in her spelling test.
<emptyline>
Who did better? You must explain your answer.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's calculate the percentage score for both.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Freya's score}      &= \dfrac {16} {20} \times 100 \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {16 \times 100} {20} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {16 \times 5 \times 20} {20} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {16 \times 5 \times \cancel{20}} {\cancel{20}} \\\\
                           &= 16 \times 5 \\\\
                           &= 80 \% \\\\
\text {Hannah's score}     &= 85 \%
\end{aligned}
$

From the calculation above, Hannah did better than Freya.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\text {Hannah}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bridge is built across a river. One quarter of the bridge is over the left bank of the river and one third of the bridge is over the right bank.

The river is $84 \ \text{m}$ wide. 

How long is the bridge?


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bridge is built across a river. One quarter of the bridge is over the left bank of the river and one third of the bridge is over the right bank.
<emptyline>
The river is $84 \ \text{m}$ wide. 
<emptyline>
How long is the bridge?
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the length of the bridge $= L \ \text{m}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Portions over banks}  &= \dfrac{L}{4} + \dfrac{L}{3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{3L}{4 \times 3} + \dfrac{4L}{3 \times 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{3L}{12} + \dfrac{4L}{12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{7L}{12} \\\\
\text{Portion over river}   &= L - \dfrac{7L}{12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{12L}{12} - \dfrac{7L}{12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5L}{12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5 \times 84}{12}  \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5 \times 7 \times 12}{12}  \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5 \times 7 \times \cancel{12}}{\cancel{12}}  \\\\
                            &= 35 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$35 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many $6 \ \text{cm}$ pieces of string can be 
cut from a piece of string $50 \ \text{cm}$ long? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many $6 \ \text{cm}$ pieces of string can be 
cut from a piece of string $50 \ \text{cm}$ long? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {No. of pieces}   &= \dfrac {\text {Total length of the string}} {\text {Length of a piece}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {50} {6} \\\\
                        &= 8 \ \text{remainder} \ 2 \\\\
                        &\approx 8 \ \text {pieces}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8 \ \text {pieces}$

**Question**

Angus and his six friends have collected $756$ football stickers, which they all share out equally.  
How many stickers do they each get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Angus and his six friends have collected $756$ football stickers, which they all share out equally.  
How many stickers do they each get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Stickers each get}                 &= \dfrac {\text{Total stickers}} {\text{Total people}} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {756} {7} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {7 \times 108} {7} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {\cancel{7} \times 108} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
                                              &= 108
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

Amar works for $45$ weeks each year. 
His total cost of travelling to and from work is $\pounds 630$ each year. 
How much is that per week?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Amar works for $45$ weeks each year. 
His total cost of travelling to and from work is $\pounds 630$ each year. 
How much is that per week?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Travelling cost per week}        &= \dfrac {\text{Total cost each year}} {\text{No. of weeks}} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {630} {45} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {14 \times 45} {45} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {14 \times \cancel{45}} {\cancel{45}} \\\\
                                              &= \pounds 14
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

At Redville Primary School, $16$ of the teachers travel to work by car, $6$ travel by bus and the other $3$ walk. 

|  Car | Bus | Walk |
|:----:|:---:|:----:|
| $16$ | $6$ |  $3$ |

What *percentage* of the teachers travel by car?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At Redville Primary School, $16$ of the teachers travel to work by car, $6$ travel by bus and the other $3$ walk. 
<emptyline>
|  Car | Bus | Walk |
|:----:|:---:|:----:|
| $16$ | $6$ |  $3$ |
<emptyline>
What *percentage* of the teachers travel by car?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage of teachers}       &= \dfrac {\text{Teachers who travel by car}} {\text{Total teachers}} \times 100 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {16} {16 + 6 + 3} \times 100 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {16 \times 100} {25} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {16 \times 4 \times 25} {25} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {16 \times 4 \times \cancel{25}} {\cancel{25}} \\\\
                                    &= 16 \times 4 \\\\
                                    &= 64 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$64 \%$

</div>
</div>

                                    &= \dfrac {16} {16 + 6 + 3} \times 100 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {16 \times 100} {25} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {16 \times 4 \times 25} {25} \\\\

\end{aligned}
$

How many peanuts did Monkey $D$ eat?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many peanuts did Monkey $D$ eat?

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey A}        &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {60} {2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {30 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
                                        &= 30 \\\\
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey B}          &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times (60 - 30) \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {30} {3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {10 \times 3} {3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                        &= 10 \\\\
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey C}          &= \dfrac {1} {4} \times (60 - 30 - 10) \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {20} {4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                        &= 5 \\\\
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey D}          &= \dfrac {1} {5} \times (60 - 30 - 10 - 5) \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {15} {5} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5} \\\\
                                        &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $50 \%$ of $20 \%$ of $6000$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $50 \%$ of $20 \%$ of $6000$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 50 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 6000 \\\\
&= \dfrac {50} {100} \times \dfrac {20} {100} \times 6000 \\\\
&= \dfrac {50 \times 20 \times 6000} {100 \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0 \times 60 \cancel {00}} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel {00}} \\\\
&= 5 \times 2 \times 60 \\\\
&= 10 \times 60 \\\\
&= 600
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$600$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$

&= 50 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 6000 \\\\

&= \dfrac {50 \times 20 \times 6000} {100 \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0 \times 60 \cancel {00}} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel {00}} \\\\
&= 5 \times 2 \times 60 \\\\
&= 10 \times 60 \\\\
&= 600
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

At Ali's shop, a multipack of $8$ toilet rolls costs $\pounds 2.40$. 

At Mya's shop, the cost per toilet roll is twice as much. 

How much is a pack of $3$ toilet rolls at Mya's shop?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At Ali's shop, a multipack of $8$ toilet rolls costs $\pounds 2.40$. 
<emptyline>
At Mya's shop, the cost per toilet roll is twice as much. 
<emptyline>
How much is a pack of $3$ toilet rolls at Mya's shop?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost at Ali's shop}                   &= \dfrac {2.40} {8} \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 0.30 \\\\
\text{Cost at Mya's shop}                   &= 0.30 \times 2 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 0.60 \\\\
\text{Cost of 3 rolls at Mya's shop}        &= 0.60 \times 3 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 1.80
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.80$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Twelve people (and no more) can sit evenly spaced around a square table. 

Deesha puts eight of these square tables together in a row to make one very long rectangular table. 

What is the maximum number of people that can sit evenly spaced around this long table?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Twelve people (and no more) can sit evenly spaced around a square table. 
<emptyline>
Deesha puts eight of these square tables together in a row to make one very long rectangular table. 
<emptyline>
What is the maximum number of people that can sit evenly spaced around this long table?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The long rectangle has $2$ long sides and $2$ short sides.

Each short side is same as $1$ side of a square table.
Each square table contributes one segment of the long side. Each long side is same as side of $8$ square tables.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of people on each side of square table}    &= \dfrac {12} {4} \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                                        &= 3 \\\\
\text{Number of people on long table}          & = 2 \times \text{(people on short sides)} + 2 \times \text{(people on long sides)} \\\\     
&= 2 \times 3 + 2 \times 8 \times 3  \\\\
                                                        &= 6 + 48 \\\\
                                                        &= 54
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$54$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Granny takes one a day of each of two types of tablet. 

One type of tablet is in packets of $25$ and the other type is in packets of $20$. 

She starts new packets of both on $1 ^ \text{st}$ March. 

On what date will she next start new packets of both?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Granny takes one a day of each of two types of tablet. 
<emptyline>
One type of tablet is in packets of $25$ and the other type is in packets of $20$. 
<emptyline>
She starts new packets of both on $1 ^ \text{st}$ March. 
<emptyline>
On what date will she next start new packets of both?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

She will next start new packets of both on a day that is a common multiple of $20$ and $25$ days after $1 ^ \text{st}$ March.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of days}          &= \text{LCM of 20 and 25} \\\\
                                        &= 100 \\\\
\text{Date}                    &= 1 \text{st March} + 100 \ \text{days} \\\\
                                        &= 8 \text{th June}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8 \text{th June}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

My flask holds $480 \ \text{ml}$ when it is one quarter empty.

How much does it hold when it is one quarter full?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">My flask holds $480 \ \text{ml}$ when it is one quarter empty.
<emptyline>
How much does it hold when it is one quarter full?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the capacity of the flask $=a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {3} {4} \times a                 &= 480 \\\\
\dfrac {3 \times a} {4}                 &= 480 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                          &= \dfrac {480} {3} \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                          &= \dfrac {3 \times 160} {3} \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                          &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 160} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                          &= 160 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Capacity when one quarter full $= 160 \ \text{ml}$
</div>

![papers/bancrofts-school/2018/sample-paper-4/s01-q11-s02-i00.png](/assets/papers/bancrofts-school/2018/sample-paper-4/s01-q11-s02-i00.png "papers/bancrofts-school/2018/sample-paper-4/s01-q11-s02-i00.png")

In the diagram, the small squares are all the same size.

What fraction of the large square is shaded?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="workings">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Shaded squares}            &= 9 \\\\
\text{Unshaded squares}          &= 4 + 8 \times \dfrac {1} {2} + 4 \times \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
                                 &= 4 + \dfrac {8} {2} + \dfrac {4} {4} \\\\
                                 &= 4 + 4 + 1 \\\\
                                 &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of shaded squares}          &= \dfrac {\text{Shaded squares}} {\text{Total squares}} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {9} {9 + 9} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {9} {18} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {9} {2 \times 9} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel 9} {2 \times \cancel 9} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Dave has a lot of tables.

Each rectangular table seats $8$ people.

Each round table seats $5$ people.

What is the smallest number of tables of each type that 
Dave needs to use to seat $35$ friends and himself, without any empty seats? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Dave has a lot of tables.
<emptyline>
Each rectangular table seats $8$ people.
<emptyline>
Each round table seats $5$ people.
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of tables of each type that 
Dave needs to use to seat $35$ friends and himself, without any empty seats? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Total people $= 35 + 1 = 36$

Let the number of rectangular tables $= r$

Let the number of round tables $= c$

As per the question,

$8r + 5c = 36$

We have only $1$ equation with $2$ variables. This can be solved by trial and error.

| $r$   | $c$                                    | $c$ integer? |
|:-------------:|:--------------------------------------------------|:------------:|
| $1$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 1) \div 5 = 28 \div 5 = 5.6$  | No           |
| $2$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 2) \div 5 = 20 \div 5 = 4$    | Yes         |
| $3$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 3) \div 5 = 12 \div 5 = 2.4$  | No           |
| $4$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 4) \div 5 = 4 \div 5 = 0.8$   | No           |

Number of rectangular tables $= 2$

Number of round tables $= 4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

rectangular tables $=$ $2$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

round tables $=$ $4$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Fill in each box with either $+$ or $-$ to make the answer of $100$.

$
123 \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \
45  \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \ 
67  \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \ 
89  \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \ = \ 100
$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Fill in each box with either $+$ or $-$ to make the answer of $100$.
<emptyline>
$
123 \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \
45  \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \ 
67  \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \

$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$

67  \ \boxed{\ + \ } \ 
89 = \ 100
$

Let's verify.

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 123 - 45 - 67 + 89 \\\\
&= 123 - 112 + 89 \\\\
&= 11 + 89 \\\\
&= 100
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Last year, $275$ of the $500$ pupils at Woodgreen School were boys.

This year, there are $540$ pupils in the school but the proportion of boys is the same as last year.

How many boys are at the school this year?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Last year, $275$ of the $500$ pupils at Woodgreen School were boys.
<emptyline>
This year, there are $540$ pupils in the school but the proportion of boys is the same as last year.
<emptyline>
How many boys are at the school this year?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of boys this year $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a} {540}                    &= \dfrac {275} {500} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {540 \times 275} {500} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {27 \times 20 \times 25 \times 11} {25 \times 20} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {27 \times \cancel {20} \times \cancel {25} \times 11} {\cancel {25} \times \cancel {20}} \\\\
a                                   &= 27 \times 11 \\\\
a                                   &= 297
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$297$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Maya cuts a $6 \ \text{metre}$ piece of string unto three different pieces.

The longest piece is $40 \ \text{cm}$ longer than the middle piece.

The middle piece is $70 \ \text{cm}$ longer than the shorter piece.

How long (in centimetres) is the longest piece?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Maya cuts a $6 \ \text{metre}$ piece of string unto three different pieces.
<emptyline>
The longest piece is $40 \ \text{cm}$ longer than the middle piece.
<emptyline>
The middle piece is $70 \ \text{cm}$ longer than the shorter piece.
<emptyline>
How long (in centimetres) is the longest piece?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the longest piece length     $= a \ \text{cm}$

Length of middle piece           $= (a - 40) \ \text{cm}$

Length of shortest piece           $= (a - 40 - 70) \ \text{cm}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \ \text{cm} + (a - 40) \ \text{cm} + (a - 40 - 70) \ \text{cm}   &= 6 \ \text{m} \\\\
a \ \text{cm} + (a - 40) \ \text{cm} + (a - 110) \ \text{cm}   &= 6 \times 100 \ \text{cm} \\\\
a + a - 40 + a - 110                                           &= 6 \times 100 \\\\
3a - 150                                               &= 600 \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac {600 + 150} {3} \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac {750} {3} \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac {3 \times 250} {3} \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 250} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                                              &= 250 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Longest piece length $= 250 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$250 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A car journey starts at $10{:}27 \ \text{am}$ and finishes at $1{:}24 \ \text{pm}$. 

How many minutes did the journey take?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A car journey starts at $10{:}27 \ \text{am}$ and finishes at $1{:}24 \ \text{pm}$. 
<emptyline>
How many minutes did the journey take?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Duration of journey}   &= 1{:}24 \ \text{pm} - 10{:}27 \ \text{am} \\\\
                             &= 2 \ \text{hours} + 57 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                             &= 2 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 57 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                             &= 120 + 57 \\\\
                             &= 177 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

A child is $13$ years old and their parent is $40$ years old. 

In how many years' time will it be before the parent is exactly twice the child's age?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A child is $13$ years old and their parent is $40$ years old. 
<emptyline>
In how many years' time will it be before the parent is exactly twice the child's age?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of years $= t \ \text{years}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
40 + t                              &= 2 \times (13 + t) \\\\
40 + t                              &= 2 \times 13 + 2 \times t \\\\
40 + t                              &= 26 + 2t \\\\
2t - t                              &= 40 - 26 \\\\
t                                   &= 14 \ \text{years}
\end{aligned}
$

Number of years $= 14 \ \text{years}$
</div>

**Question**

I am facing South East. I then turn $225$ degrees anticlockwise. 

What direction am I facing now?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I am facing South East. I then turn $225$ degrees anticlockwise. 
<emptyline>
What direction am I facing now?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Directions in order anticlockwise:

- East ($0 \degree$)
- North ($90  \degree$)
- West ($180  \degree$)
- South ($270  \degree$)

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{South East direction}         &= 315 \degree \\\\
\text{Current direction}            &= 315 \degree + 225 \degree \\\\
                                    &= 540 \degree \\\\
                                    &= 540 \degree - 360 \degree \\\\
                                    &= 180 \degree \\\\
                                    &= \text{West}
\end{aligned}
$

Current direction $= \text{West}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\text{West}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Dave has a lot of tables.

Each rectangular table seats $8$ people.

Each round table seats $5$ people.

What is the smallest number of tables of each type that 
Dave needs to use to seat $35$ friends and himself, without any empty seats? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Dave has a lot of tables.
<emptyline>
Each rectangular table seats $8$ people.
<emptyline>
Each round table seats $5$ people.
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of tables of each type that 
Dave needs to use to seat $35$ friends and himself, without any empty seats? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Total people $= 35 + 1 = 36$

Let the number of rectangular tables $= r$

Let the number of round tables $= c$

As per the question,

$8r + 5c = 36$

We have only $1$ equation with $2$ variables. This can be solved by trial and error.

| $r$   | $c$                                    | $c$ integer? |
|:-------------:|:--------------------------------------------------|:------------:|
| $1$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 1) \div 5 = 28 \div 5 = 5.6$  | No           |
| $2$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 2) \div 5 = 20 \div 5 = 4$    | Yes         |
| $3$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 3) \div 5 = 12 \div 5 = 2.4$  | No           |
| $4$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 4) \div 5 = 4 \div 5 = 0.8$   | No           |

Number of rectangular tables $= 2$

Number of round tables $= 4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

rectangular tables $=$ $2$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

round tables $=$ $4$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A farmer has $364$ ewes and each ewe has either one or two new born lambs. 
If there are $468$ lambs in total, how many of the ewes have twin lambs?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A farmer has $364$ ewes and each ewe has either one or two new born lambs. 
If there are $468$ lambs in total, how many of the ewes have twin lambs?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of ewes with twin lambs $= a$

Number of ewes with one born lamb $= 364 - a$

As per the questions,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 2 + (364 - a) \times 1     &= 468 \\\\
2a + 364 - a                        &= 468 \\\\
a + 364                             &= 468 \\\\
a                                   &= 468 - 364 \\\\
a                                   &= 104
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$104$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Eleanor receives $\pounds 20$ pocket money each week.
This week, she spent $\pounds 4.88$ on sweets at the shop.
She then put a third of what was left in her piggy bank.

How much money does she still have to spend?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Eleanor receives $\pounds 20$ pocket money each week.
This week, she spent $\pounds 4.88$ on sweets at the shop.
She then put a third of what was left in her piggy bank.
<emptyline>
How much money does she still have to spend?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money left after sweets}      &= 20 - 4.88 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 15.12 \\\\
\text{Money put in piggy bank}      &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times 15.12 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {15.12} {3} \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 5.04 \\\\
\text{Money left}                   &= 20 - (4.88 + 5.04) \\\\
                                    &= 20 - (4.88 + 5.04) \\\\
                                    &= 20 - 9.92 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 10.08
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 10.08$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

As everyone knows, a normal cat has $18$ claws, $5$ on each 
front leg and $4$ on each back leg.

At Harry's Care Home for Distressed Cats there are 
$4$ three-legged cats, each one with a different leg missing.

How many claws do they have all together?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">As everyone knows, a normal cat has $18$ claws, $5$ on each 
front leg and $4$ on each back leg.
<emptyline>
At Harry's Care Home for Distressed Cats there are 
$4$ three-legged cats, each one with a different leg missing.
<emptyline>
How many claws do they have all together?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

There are $4$ cats, each missing a different leg. So the missing legs are:

- Missing front left: $5$ claws
- Missing front right: $5$ claws
- Missing back left: $4$ claws
- Missing back right: $4$ claws

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total claws per cat}          &= 5 \times 2 + 4 \times 2 \\\\
                                    &= 10 + 8 \\\\
                                    &= 18 \\\\
\text{Claws lost by cats}           &= 5 + 5 + 4 + 4 \\\\
\text{Total claws}                  &= 4 \times 18 - (5 + 5 + 4 + 4) \\\\
                                    &= 72 - 18 \\\\
                                    &= 54
\end{aligned}
$

Total claws $= 54$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$54$

</div>
</div>

- Missing back right: $4$ claws

$

                                    &= 10 + 8 \\\\
                                    &= 18 \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

John the electrician needs to cut three lengths of wire from the $5 \ \text{metre}$ roll he has brought with him to do a job. The three lengths he cuts are $85 \ \text{cm}$, $2.5 \ \text{metres}$ and $650 \ \text{mm}$. How much wire (in cms) will he have left after cutting off his lengths?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John the electrician needs to cut three lengths of wire from the $5 \ \text{metre}$ roll he has brought with him to do a job. The three lengths he cuts are $85 \ \text{cm}$, $2.5 \ \text{metres}$ and $650 \ \text{mm}$. How much wire (in cms) will he have left after cutting off his lengths?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total wire length} &= 5 \ \text{m} \\\\
                         &= 5 \times 100 \\\\
                         &= 500 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Total length cut}  &= 85 \ \text{cm} + 2.5 \ \text{m} + 650 \ \text{mm} \\\\
                         &= 85 \ \text{cm} + 250 \ \text{cm} + 65 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                         &= 85 + 250 + 65 \\\\
                         &= 400 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Wire left}         &= 500 - 400 \\\\
                         &= 100 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$100 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">- rtq_abbr_note_md_unit
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

\text{Total length cut}  &= 85 \ \text{cm} + 2.5 \ \text{m} + 650 \ \text{mm} \\\\
                         &= 85 \ \text{cm} + 250 \ \text{cm} + 65 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                         &= 85 + 250 + 65 \\\\
                         &= 400 \ \text{cm} \\\\

                         &= 100 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

*Lathes Engineering* produces ten boxes of screws every minute. It has to produce $48{,}000$ boxes of screws in five days. If its machines work an equal amount of time each day, work out the number of hours which will be needed **__each day__** to produce the boxes of screws needed.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">*Lathes Engineering* produces ten boxes of screws every minute. It has to produce $48{,}000$ boxes of screws in five days. If its machines work an equal amount of time each day, work out the number of hours which will be needed **__each day__** to produce the boxes of screws needed.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of boxes produced every minute}    &= 10 \\\\
\text{Number of boxes produced every hour}      &= 60 \times 10 \\\\
                                                &= 600 \\\\
\text{Number of working hours each day}         &= \dfrac {48000} {5 \times 600} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {600 \times 5 \times 16} {5 \times 600} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {600} \times \cancel 5 \times 16} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel {600}} \\\\
                                                &= 16 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16 \ \text{hours}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ben has $\pounds 68$. He gives a quarter of this to his sister. How much does he have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ben has $\pounds 68$. He gives a quarter of this to his sister. How much does he have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money given to sister} &= \dfrac{1}{4} \times 68 \\\\
&= \dfrac{68}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{4 \times 17}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel{4} \times 17}{\cancel{4}} \\\\
&= \pounds 17 \\\\
\text{Money left} &= 68 - 17 \\\\
&= \pounds 51
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 51$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the total cost of $\dfrac{1}{2} \ \text{kg}$ of grapes, $2$ melons and $3$ punnets of nectarines? Give your answer in $\pounds$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the total cost of $\dfrac{1}{2} \ \text{kg}$ of grapes, $2$ melons and $3$ punnets of nectarines? Give your answer in $\pounds$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of grapes} &= \dfrac{1}{2} \times 1.54  \\\\
&= \pounds 0.77 \\\\
\text{Cost of melons} &= 2 \times 1.79  \\\\
&= \pounds 3.58 \\\\
\text{Cost of nectarines} &= 3 \times 0.87  \\\\
&= \pounds 2.61 \\\\
\text{Total Cost} &= 0.77 + 3.58 + 2.61 \\\\
&= \pounds 6.96
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which is greater $90 \%$ of $10 \%$ of $300$ or $80 \%$ of $20 \%$ of $200?$ 

You must show calculations to explain your answer.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which is greater $90 \%$ of $10 \%$ of $300$ or $80 \%$ of $20 \%$ of $200?$ 
<emptyline>
You must show calculations to explain your answer.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned} 
\text{First number}     &= 90 \% \ \text {of} \ 10 \% \ \text {of} \ 300 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {90} {100} \times \dfrac {10} {100} \times 300 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {90 \times 10 \times 300} {100 \times 100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {9 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0 \times 3 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                        &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
                        &= 27 \\\\
\text{Second number}    &= 80 \% \ \text {of} \ 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 200 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {80} {100} \times \dfrac {20} {100} \times 200 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {80 \times 20 \times 200} {100 \times 100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {8 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                        &= 8 \times 2 \times 2 \\\\
                        &= 32
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 80 \%  \text { of }  20 \%  \text{ of } 200$
</div>
</div>

Missing letter $= \text{M}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A cafe sold $40$ sandwiches on Monday.
$45 \%$ of the sandwiches were vegetarian. How many vegetarian sandwiches did the cafe sell?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A cafe sold $40$ sandwiches on Monday.
$45 \%$ of the sandwiches were vegetarian. How many vegetarian sandwiches did the cafe sell?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Vegetarian sandwiches sold}     &= 45 \% \ \text {of} \ \text {total sandwiches} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {45} {100} \times 40 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {45 \times 40} {100} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {9 \times 5 \times 20 \times 2} {20 \times 5} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {9 \times \cancel {5} \times \cancel {20} \times 2} {\cancel {20} \times \cancel {5}} \\\\
                                        &= 9 \times 2 \\\\
                                        &= 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A Fones4U store has $96$ phones in stock.
Three-eighths of them are Android phones. How many Android phones does it have in stock?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A Fones4U store has $96$ phones in stock.
Three-eighths of them are Android phones. How many Android phones does it have in stock?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Android Phones}  &= \dfrac {3} {8} \ \text {of} \ 96 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3} {8} \times 96 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 96} {8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 12 \times 8} {8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 12 \times \cancel {8}} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
                        &= 3 \times 12 \\\\
                        &= 36
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$36$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

At an England v Australia rugby match, there were $76432$ spectators.
$8695$ of these spectators were supporting Australia, and the rest were supporting England.

How many spectators were supporting England?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At an England v Australia rugby match, there were $76432$ spectators.
$8695$ of these spectators were supporting Australia, and the rest were supporting England.
<emptyline>
How many spectators were supporting England?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Spectators supporting England}  &= \text {Total spectators} - \text {Spectators supporting Australia} \\\\
                                       &= 76432 - 8695 \\\\
                                       &= 67737
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The fraction one eighth is roughly the same as one of these percentages. Put a ring around the best one.

$10 \%  \quad 12 \%  \quad 14 \%  \quad 16 \%  \quad 18 \%$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The fraction one eighth is roughly the same as one of these percentages. Put a ring around the best one.
<emptyline>
$10 \%  \quad 12 \%  \quad 14 \%  \quad 16 \%  \quad 18 \%$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {8} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {8} \times 100 \% \\\\
&= \dfrac {100} {8} \% \\\\
&= \dfrac {25 \times 4} {2 \times 4} \% \\\\
&= \dfrac {25 \times \cancel {4}} {2 \times \cancel {4}} \% \\\\
&= \dfrac {25} {2} \% \\\\
&= 12.5 \%
\end{aligned}
$

The best answer is $= 12 \%$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$12 \%$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

You can buy a new calculator for $\pounds 1.25$.

In $1979$ the same type of calculator cost $22$ times as much as it costs now. 

How much did the same type of calculator cost in $1979?$

Show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

How much did the same type of calculator cost in $1979?$
<emptyline>
Show your working.
</code></pre>

                                       &= \pounds 27.50
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Martin is given $\pounds 240$. He gives $\dfrac{1}{8}$ to his sister and $\dfrac{1}{5}$ of what remains to his little brother. How much does he keep himself?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Martin is given $\pounds 240$. He gives $\dfrac{1}{8}$ to his sister and $\dfrac{1}{5}$ of what remains to his little brother. How much does he keep himself?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Amount given} &= \text {Amount given to sister} + \text {Amount given to brother} \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {1} {8} \times 240 + \dfrac {1} {5} \times (240 - \dfrac {1} {8} \times 240) \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {1} {8} \times 240 + \dfrac {1} {5} \times 240 - \dfrac {1} {5} \times \dfrac {1} {8} \times 240 \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {240} {8} + \dfrac {240} {5} - \dfrac {240} {5 \times 8} \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {8 \times 30} {8} + \dfrac {5 \times 48} {5} - \dfrac {5 \times 8 \times 6} {5 \times 8} \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {\cancel 8 \times 30} {\cancel 8} + \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 48} {\cancel 5} - \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 8 \times 6} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 8} \\\\
                     &= 30 + 48 - 6 \\\\
                     &= 30 + 42 \\\\
                     &= \pounds 72 \\\\
\text {Amount left}  &= \text {Total amount} - \text {Amount spent} \\\\
                     &= 240 - 72 \\\\
                     &= \pounds 168
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
