<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Rowan sends $7$ text messages each day.

A $\pounds 5$ credit buys him $140$ text messages.

Today he received an extra $15\%$ free text messages when he bought his $\pounds 5$ credit. How many days should the credit last? Show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Rowan sends $7$ text messages each day.
<emptyline>
A $\pounds 5$ credit buys him $140$ text messages.
<emptyline>
Today he received an extra $15\%$ free text messages when he bought his $\pounds 5$ credit. How many days should the credit last? Show your working.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If Rowand receives an extra $15\%$ free text messages then new total messages will be $100 + 15 = 115\%$ of the original messages.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total messages}                      &= \dfrac {115} {100} \times 140 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {115 \times 140} {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 23 \times 2 \times 7 \times 10} {5 \times 2 \times 10} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 23 \times \cancel{2} \times 7 \times \cancel{10}} {\cancel{5} \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{10}} \\\\
                                            &= 23 \times 7 \\\\
                                            &= 161 \\\\
\text{Number of days}                       &= \dfrac {161} {7} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {7 \times 23} {7} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 7 \times 23} {\cancel 7} \\\\
                                            &= 23
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$23$

</div>
</div>

                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 23 \times \cancel{2} \times 7 \times \cancel{10}} {\cancel{5} \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{10}} \\\\

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In $2016$, the park made $\pounds 360$ from ticket sales. Tickets were $\pounds 4.50$.

How much money does the director think the theme park will make in $2017$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In $2016$, the park made $\pounds 360$ from ticket sales. Tickets were $\pounds 4.50$.
<emptyline>
How much money does the director think the theme park will make in $2017$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the price is reduced by one-third, the new price will be $1 - \dfrac {1} {3} = \dfrac {2} {3}$ of the original price.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{People in 2016}                             &= \dfrac {360} {4.5} \\\\
                                                            &= \dfrac {360 \times 10} {45} \\\\
                                                            &= \dfrac {9 \times 40 \times 2 \times 5} {9 \times 5} \\\\
                                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 40 \times 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 9 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                                                            &= 40 \times 2 \\\\
                                                            &= 80 \\\\
\text{People in 2017}                             &= 2 \times 80 \\\\
                                                            &= 160 \\\\
\text{Price of ticket in 2017}                              &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times 4.5 \\\\
                                                            &= \dfrac {2 \times 4.5} {3} \\\\
                                                            &= \dfrac {9} {3} \\\\
                                                            &= \pounds 3 \\\\
\text{Total money in 2017}             &= 3 \times 160 \\\\
                                                            &= \pounds 480
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 480$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If the price is reduced by one-third, the new price will be $1 - \dfrac {1} {3} = \dfrac {2} {3}$ of the original price.

                                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 40 \times 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 9 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                                                            &= 40 \times 2 \\\\

                                                            &= \dfrac {9} {3} \\\\
                                                            &= \pounds 3 \\\\

$

**Question**

In fact, the theme park makes $\pounds 390$. How many more people went to the theme park in $2017$ compared to $2016?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

\begin{aligned}
\text{People in 2017}         &= \dfrac {\text{Money made in 2017}} {\text{Price of a ticket}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {390} {3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 130} {3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 130} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                        &= 130 \\\\
\text{Difference}           &= 130 - 80 \\\\
                            &= 50
\end{aligned}
$

$50$ more people went to theme park in $2017$.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A field is planted with cabbages in rows.
Each row contains $22$ cabbage seeds and there are $39$ rows. How many cabbage seeds are there in the field?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A teacher shares a large packet of sweets evenly to her class of $24$ pupils and then eats the left over sweets.
There were $170$ sweets in the packet, how many does the teacher eat?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A teacher shares a large packet of sweets evenly to her class of $24$ pupils and then eats the left over sweets.
There were $170$ sweets in the packet, how many does the teacher eat?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sweets per pupil}     &= \dfrac {170} {24} \\\\
                            &= 7 \text{ remainder } 2 \\\\
                            &\approx 7 \\\\
\text{Sweets teacher ate}   &= \text{Total sweets} - \text{Sweets for pupils} \\\\
                            &= 170 - 24 \times 7 \\\\
                            &= 170 - 168 \\\\
                            &= 2
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Anna decides to share her pizza with two of her friends.
She gives one friend a fifth of the pizza and the other friend three tenths of the pizza.
What fraction of the pizza is left for Anna?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Anna decides to share her pizza with two of her friends.
She gives one friend a fifth of the pizza and the other friend three tenths of the pizza.
What fraction of the pizza is left for Anna?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Fraction left for Anna}  &= \text {Whole pizza} - \text {1st friends share} - \text {2nd friends share} \\\\
                                &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {5} - \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {1 \times 10} {1 \times 10} - \dfrac {1 \times 2} {5 \times 2} - \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {10} {10} - \dfrac {2} {10} - \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {10 - 2 - 3} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {5} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {5} {5 \times 2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {5}} {\cancel {5} \times 2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {2}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Fraction left for Anna}  &= \text {Whole pizza} - \text {1st friends share} - \text {2nd friends share} \\\\
                                &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {5} - \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {1 \times 10} {1 \times 10} - \dfrac {1 \times 2} {5 \times 2} - \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {10} {10} - \dfrac {2} {10} - \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {10 - 2 - 3} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {5} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {5} {5 \times 2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {5}} {\cancel {5} \times 2} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answercodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac {1} {2}$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jordan has a collection of $1345$ marbles! He gives his friend $689$ of the marbles. How many does Jordan have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                                  &= 1345 - 689 \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A new mobile phone app is sold for $79 \ \text{pence}$ per download and proves to be
very popular so that $150$ people are downloading the app every day.
The person who created the app gets $44 \ \text{pence}$ every time it is downloaded
and she gets paid at the end of each week.

How many weeks will it take for her to have $\pounds 2,000?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A new mobile phone app is sold for $79 \ \text{pence}$ per download and proves to be
very popular so that $150$ people are downloading the app every day.
The person who created the app gets $44 \ \text{pence}$ every time it is downloaded
and she gets paid at the end of each week.
<emptyline>
How many weeks will it take for her to have $\pounds 2,000?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Earning per week}       &= 44 \times 150 \times 7 \\\\
                                    &= 46200 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 462 \\\\
\text{Weeks needed}         &= \dfrac {2000} {462} \\\\
                                        &= 4 \ \text{remainder} \ 152 \\\\
                                        &\approx 5 \ \text{weeks}
\end{aligned}
$

It will take $5$ weeks for her to have $\pounds 2000$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5 \ \text{weeks}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

For question $1$ to $3$ use this information:

A box contains $54$ biscuits of which $16$ are chocolate.

How many biscuits are not chocolate?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

<emptyline>
A box contains $54$ biscuits of which $16$ are chocolate.
<emptyline>
How many biscuits are not chocolate?
</code></pre>

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

           &= 38
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many people can have four biscuits each?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

**Question**

How many biscuits are there in seven boxes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I cook rice for four people. I use $60 \ \text{grams}$ per person. How much, in grammes, remains from a $1 \ \text{kilogram}$ packet?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I cook rice for four people. I use $60 \ \text{grams}$ per person. How much, in grammes, remains from a $1 \ \text{kilogram}$ packet?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Rice left}        &= \text{Total rice} - \text{Rice used in cooking} \\\\
                        &= 1 \ \text{kg} - 4 \times 60 \ \text{g} \\\\
                        &= 1000 \ \text{g} - 4 \times 60 \ \text{g} \\\\
                        &= 1000 - 4 \times 60 \\\\
                        &= 1000 - 240 \\\\
                        &= 760 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$760 \ \text{g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A giant size toy box contains $400$ bricks. How many bricks will there be in $36$ boxes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A giant size toy box contains $400$ bricks. How many bricks will there be in $36$ boxes?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total bricks}     &= \text{Number of boxes} \times \text{Number of bricks in each boxes} \\\\
                        &= 36 \times 400 \\\\
                        &= 14400
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

One day in January only $55\%$ of a class of $40$ chidren were present at school.

How many pupils were present?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">One day in January only $55\%$ of a class of $40$ chidren were present at school.
<emptyline>
How many pupils were present?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pupils present}      &= 55 \% \ \text{of} \ 40 \\\\
                                     &= \dfrac {55} {100} \times 40 \\\\
                                     &= \dfrac {55 \times 40} {100} \\\\
                                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 11 \times 2 \times 20} {5 \times 20} \\\\
                                     &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 11 \times 2 \times \cancel {20} } {\cancel{5} \times \cancel {20}} \\\\
                                     &= 11 \times 2 \\\\
                                     &= 22
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$22$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The following day $24$ pupils were present, out of $40$. Write this as a percentage.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The following day $24$ pupils were present, out of $40$. Write this as a percentage.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage of pupils present}     &= \dfrac {24} {40} \times 100 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {24 \times 100} {40} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 20 \times 5} {8 \times 5} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {8} \times 3 \times 20 \times \cancel {5} } {\cancel {8} \times \cancel {5} } \\\\
                                        &= 3 \times 20 \\\\
                                        &= 60 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Chocolate bars are packed in boxes of $36$.

A shop buys $14$ boxes.

How many chocolate bars are in $14$ boxes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Chocolate bars are packed in boxes of $36$.
<emptyline>
A shop buys $14$ boxes.
<emptyline>
How many chocolate bars are in $14$ boxes?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total chocolates}     &= \text{Number of boxes} \times \text{Number of chocolates in each box} \\\\    
                            &= 14 \times 36 \\\\
                            &= 504
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{Boxes}                                &:& \text{Chocolates} \\\\
= & 1                                           &:& 36 \\\\
= & 1 \times 14                                 &:& 36 \times 14 \\\\
= & 14                                          &:& 504
\end{array}
$

Number of chocolates in $14$ boxes $= 504$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$504$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A minibus carries $12$ pupils.

How many buses would be needed to take $248$ pupils?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A minibus carries $12$ pupils.
<emptyline>
How many buses would be needed to take $248$ pupils?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Buses needed}     &= \dfrac {\text{Total pupils}} {\text{Capacity of one bus}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {248} {12} \\\\
                        &= 20 \text{ remainder } 8 \\\\
                        &\approx 21
\end{aligned}
$

We need $1$ more bus for the remaining $8$ pupils.

Total buses = $20 + 1 = 21$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>

**Question**

How many times can $143$ be subtracted from $855$ before we get to zero?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}
\text{Count}  &= \dfrac {855} {143} \\\\
                        &= 5 \text{ remainder } 140 \\\\
                        &\approx 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a bag there are $84$ counters. $\dfrac{5}{7}$ of the counters are blue. How many blue counters are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a bag there are $84$ counters. $\dfrac{5}{7}$ of the counters are blue. How many blue counters are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Blue counters}    &= \dfrac {5} {7} \times 84 \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5 \times 84} {7} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5 \times 12 \times 7} {7} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5 \times 12 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
                         &= 5 \times 12 \\\\
                         &= 60
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$60$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$8\%$ of children wear glasses. If there are $1150$ children at a school, how many wear glasses?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$8\%$ of children wear glasses. If there are $1150$ children at a school, how many wear glasses?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Children that wear glasses}   &= 8 \% \ \text{of} \ 1150 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {8} {100} \times 1150 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {8 \times 1150} {100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 2 \times 23 \times 25} {4 \times 25} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {4} \times 2 \times 2 \times 23 \times \cancel {25} } {\cancel{4} \times \cancel {25}} \\\\
                                    &= 4 \times 23 \\\\
                                    &= 92
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$92$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A full sweet jar weighs $165.5 \ \text{g}$. The jar contains $90$ sweets. Each sweet weighs $450\ \text{mg}$. How much does the empty jar weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A full sweet jar weighs $165.5 \ \text{g}$. The jar contains $90$ sweets. Each sweet weighs $450\ \text{mg}$. How much does the empty jar weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total weight of sweets}     &= 90 \times 450 \ \text {mg} \\\\
                                   &= 90 \times \dfrac {450}{1000} \text {g} \\\\
                                   &= 90 \times 0.45 \\\\
                                   &= 40.5 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {Weight of empty jar }       &= 165.5 - 40.5 \\\\
                                   &= 125 \ \text {g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$125 \ \text {g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A minibus carries $14$ pupils.
How many buses would be needed to take $300$ pupils?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A minibus carries $14$ pupils.
How many buses would be needed to take $300$ pupils?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Buses needed}     &= \dfrac {\text{Total pupils}} {\text{Capacity of one bus}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {300} {14} \\\\
                        &= 21 \text{ remainder } 6 \\\\
                        &\approx 22
\end{aligned}
$

We need $1$ more bus for the remaining $6$ pupils.

Total buses = $21 + 1 = 22$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$22$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a bag there are $63$ counters. $\dfrac {3} {7}$ of the counters are blue.  How many blue counters are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a bag there are $63$ counters. $\dfrac {3} {7}$ of the counters are blue.  How many blue counters are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Blue counters}    &= \dfrac {3} {7} \ \text{of} \ 63 \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {3} {7} \times 63 \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {3 \times 63} {7} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times 7} {7} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {3 \times 9 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
                         &= 3 \times 9 \\\\
                         &= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$6\%$ of children wear glasses. If there are $1450$ children at a school, how many wear glasses?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$6\%$ of children wear glasses. If there are $1450$ children at a school, how many wear glasses?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Children that wear glasses}   &= 6 \% \ \text{of} \ 1450 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {6} {100} \times 1450 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {6 \times 1450} {100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 2 \times 29 \times 25} {2 \times 2 \times 25} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 3 \times \cancel {2} \times 29 \times \cancel {25} } {\cancel{2} \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel {25}} \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times 29 \\\\
                                    &= 87
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$87$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A full sweet jar weighs $180.5\ \text{g}$. The jar contains $120$ sweets. Each sweet weighs $450\ \text{mg}$.
How much does the empty jar weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A full sweet jar weighs $180.5\ \text{g}$. The jar contains $120$ sweets. Each sweet weighs $450\ \text{mg}$.
How much does the empty jar weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total weight of sweets}     &= 120 \times 450 \ \text{mg} \\\\
                                   &= 120 \times \dfrac {450}{1000} \text {g} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {120 \times 450}{1000} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {6 \times 20 \times 9 \times 50}{20 \times 50} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel {20} \times 9 \times \cancel {50}}{\cancel {20} \times \cancel {50}} \\\\
                                   &= 6 \times 9 \\\\
                                   &= 54 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {Weight of empty jar }       &= 180.5 - 54 \\\\
                                   &= 126.5 \ \text {g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$126.5 \ \text {g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A train has $6$ carriages, Each carriage holds $88$ passengers. How many seats has the train have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A train has $6$ carriages, Each carriage holds $88$ passengers. How many seats has the train have?
</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total seats in train}     &= \text{Number of carriages} \times \text{Number of seats in each carriage} \\\\
                                &= 6 \times 88 \\\\
                                &= 528
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{Carriages}                           &:& \text{Seats} \\\\
= & 1                                          &:& 88 \\\\
= & 1 \times 6                                 &:& 88 \times 6 \\\\
= & 6                                          &:& 528
\end{array}
$

Number of seats in train $= 528$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$528$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two fifths of the pupils in a school wear glasses. What percentage of the pupils wear glasses?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two fifths of the pupils in a school wear glasses. What percentage of the pupils wear glasses?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage of pupils with glasses}    &= \dfrac {2} {5} \times 100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {2 \times 100} {5} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {2 \times 20 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {2 \times 20 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel{5}} \\\\
                                            &= 2 \times 20 \\\\
                                            &= 40 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$40 \%$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

The UK population is approximately $66{,}482{,}000$. The population of London is $8.78 \ \text{million}$. How many people in the UK live outside London?


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>

                                    &= 66482000 - 8.78 \times 1000000 \\\\
                                    &= 66482000 - 8780000 \\\\
                                    &= 57702000
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A stationery shop sells $6851$ pens in $31$ days. How many pens per day did they sell?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A stationery shop sells $6851$ pens in $31$ days. How many pens per day did they sell?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pens sold per day}      &= \dfrac {\text{Total pens sold}} {\text{Total number of days}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {6851} {31} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {221 \times 31} {31} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {221 \times \cancel {31}} {\cancel {31}} \\\\
                                        &= 221
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$221$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A medicine bottle contains $90$ pills. Each pill weighs $250 \  \text{mg}$, The full bottle weighs $160 \  \text{g}$. How much does the empty bottle weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A medicine bottle contains $90$ pills. Each pill weighs $250 \  \text{mg}$, The full bottle weighs $160 \  \text{g}$. How much does the empty bottle weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total weight of pills}      &= 90 \times 250 \ \text{mg} \\\\
                                   &= 90 \times \dfrac {250} {1000} \ \text {g} \\\\
                                   &= 90 \times 0.25 \\\\
                                   &= 22.5 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {Weight of empty bottle}     &= 160 - 22.5 \\\\
                                   &= 137.5 \ \text {g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$137.5 \ \text {g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a school $24\%$ of children have blond hair. If there are $1100$ children at a school, how many have blond hair?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a school $24\%$ of children have blond hair. If there are $1100$ children at a school, how many have blond hair?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Children that have blond hair}   &= 24 \% \ \text{of} \ 1100 \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {24} {100} \times 1100 \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {24 \times 1100} {100} \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {24 \times 11 \cancel {00} } {1 \cancel {00} } \\\\
                                       &= 24 \times 11 \\\\
                                       &= 264
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$264$

</div>

How many chocolate bars are in $16$ boxes?

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A minibus carries $16$ pupils.

How many buses would be needed to take $300$ pupils?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A minibus carries $16$ pupils.
<emptyline>
How many buses would be needed to take $300$ pupils?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of bused required} &= \dfrac {300} {16} \\\\
                                &= 18 \text{ remainder } 12 \\\\
                                &\approx 19
\end{aligned}
$

We need $1$ more bus for the remaining $12$ pupils.

Total buses = $18 + 1 = 19$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$19$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many times can $117$ be subtracted from $1200$ before we get to zero?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many times can $117$ be subtracted from $1200$ before we get to zero?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of times} &= \dfrac {1200} {117} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {3 \times 400} {3 \times 39} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 400} {\cancel 3 \times 39} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {400} {39} \\\\
                       &= 10 \text{ remainder } 10 \\\\
                       &\approx 10
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a bag there are $63$ counters. $\dfrac {5}{9}$ of the counters are blue. How many blue counters are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a bag there are $63$ counters. $\dfrac {5}{9}$ of the counters are blue. How many blue counters are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Blue counters}    &= \dfrac {5} {9} \ \text {of} \ 63 \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5} {9} \times 63 \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5 \times 63} {9} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5 \times 7 \times 9} {9} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5 \times 7 \times \cancel {9}} {\cancel {9}} \\\\
                         &= 5 \times 7 \\\\
                         &= 35
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$35$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$6 \%$ of children wear glasses. If there are $1450$ children at a school, how many wear glasses?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$6 \%$ of children wear glasses. If there are $1450$ children at a school, how many wear glasses?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Children that wear glasses}   &= 6 \% \ \text{of} \ 1450 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {6} {100} \times 1450 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {6 \times 1450} {100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 2 \times 29 \times 25} {2 \times 2 \times 25} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 3 \times \cancel {2} \times 29 \times \cancel {25} } {\cancel{2} \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel {25}} \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times 29 \\\\
                                    &= 87
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$87$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A full sweet jar weighs $180.5 \ \text{g}$. The jar contains $120$ sweets. Each sweet weighs $450 \ \text{mg}$.
How much does the empty jar weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A full sweet jar weighs $180.5 \ \text{g}$. The jar contains $120$ sweets. Each sweet weighs $450 \ \text{mg}$.
How much does the empty jar weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total weight of sweets}     &= 120 \times 450 \ \text{mg} \\\\
                                   &= 120 \times \dfrac {450}{1000} \ \text {g} \\\\
                                   &= 120 \times 0.45 \\\\
                                   &= 54 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {Weight of empty jar }       &= 180.5 - 54 \\\\
                                   &= 126.5 \ \text {g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$126.5 \ \text {g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many $15\ \text{cm}$ strips can I cut from a ribbon $1\ \text{m}$ long?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many $15\ \text{cm}$ strips can I cut from a ribbon $1\ \text{m}$ long?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of strips}    &= \dfrac {1 \ \text{m}} {15 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} {15 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 20} {5 \times 3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 20} {\cancel 5 \times 3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {20} {3} \\\\
                            &= 6 \text { remainder } 2 \\\\
                            &\approx 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box contains $48$ pencils.

If I take out $\dfrac {3} {4}$ of the pencils how many would be left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box contains $48$ pencils.
<emptyline>
If I take out $\dfrac {3} {4}$ of the pencils how many would be left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Pencils left}     &= \left( 1 - \dfrac {3} {4} \right) \times 48 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {4} \times 48 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {48} {4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {12 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {12 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} \\\\
                        &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

At the school medical centre, there are enough plasters to patch up $12$ cut knees per day for $30 \ \text{days}$. 
Work out how long the plasters would last if the medical centre were having to treat $20$ boys with cut knees a day.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At the school medical centre, there are enough plasters to patch up $12$ cut knees per day for $30 \ \text{days}$. 
Work out how long the plasters would last if the medical centre were having to treat $20$ boys with cut knees a day.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total plasters}     &= 12 \times 30 \\\\
\text{Number of days}     &= \dfrac {12 \times 30} {20} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 6 \times 3 \times 10} {2 \times 10} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac { \cancel{2} \times 6 \times 3 \times 1 \cancel{0}} { \cancel{2} \times 1 \cancel{0}} \\\\
                          &= 6 \times 3 \\\\
                          &= 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$18 \ \text{days}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Simon and Fiona are sharing a cupboard. If Simon's things take up $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the space and Fiona's things take up 
$\dfrac{2}{7}$ of the space, what fraction of the cupboard is empty? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Simon and Fiona are sharing a cupboard. If Simon's things take up $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the space and Fiona's things take up 
$\dfrac{2}{7}$ of the space, what fraction of the cupboard is empty? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Empty Space}      &= \text{Total space} - \text{Used space} \\\\
                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {2} {5} + \dfrac {2} {7}\bigg) \\\\
                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 7} {5 \times 7} + \dfrac {2 \times 5} {7 \times 5}\bigg) \\\\
                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {14} {35} + \dfrac {10} {35}\bigg) \\\\
                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {14 + 10} {35}\bigg) \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1 \times 35} {1 \times 35} - \dfrac {24} {35} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {35 - 24} {35} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {11} {35}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {11} {35}$

</div>
</div>

                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {14} {35} + \dfrac {10} {35}\bigg) \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tom uses $750 \ \text{g}$ of sugar from a $2.5 \ \text{kg}$ packet. How many kilograms of sugar are left? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tom uses $750 \ \text{g}$ of sugar from a $2.5 \ \text{kg}$ packet. How many kilograms of sugar are left? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sugar left}           &= \text{Total sugar} - \text{Sugar used by Tom} \\\\
                            &= 2.5 \ \text{kg} - 750 \ \text{g} \\\\
                            &= 2.5 \ \text{kg} - \dfrac {750} {1000} \ \text{kg} \\\\
                            &= 2.5 - 0.75 \\\\
                            &= 1.75 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$1.75 \ \text{kg}$

</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}
$

Weight of the whole cake $= 250 \ \text{grams}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A book has $256$ pages with, on average, $33$ lines on each page and $9$ words on each line.

Find an estimate for the number of words in the book.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A book has $256$ pages with, on average, $33$ lines on each page and $9$ words on each line.
<emptyline>
Find an estimate for the number of words in the book.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Estimated number of words}          &= 256 \times 33 \times 9 \\\\
                                &\approx 300 \times 30 \times 10 \\\\
                                &\approx 90000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$90000$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

It was reported recently that in an average lifetime of $70 \ \text{years}$, each
human is likely to swallow about $8$ spiders while sleeping. Supposing
that the population of UK is $60 \ \text{millions}$, what is the best
estimate of number of spiders that are consumed in this way in the 
UK each year?

- $600000$
- $7000000$
- $80000000$
- $900000000$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">It was reported recently that in an average lifetime of $70 \ \text{years}$, each
human is likely to swallow about $8$ spiders while sleeping. Supposing
that the population of UK is $60 \ \text{millions}$, what is the best
estimate of number of spiders that are consumed in this way in the 
UK each year?
<emptyline>
- $600000$
- $7000000$
- $80000000$
- $900000000$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total spiders per person per year}  &= \dfrac {8} {70} \\\\
\text{Total spiders per year in UK}       &= 60000000 \times \dfrac {8} {70} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {60000000 \times 8} {70} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {6000000 \cancel 0 \times 8} {7 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {48000000} {7} \\\\
                                          &= 6857142 \text{ remainder } 6 \\\\
                                          &\approx 7000000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>B</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7000000$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the British Army there are $4500$ men who are taller than $180 \ \text{cms}$. 
Of these $750$ are taller than $190 \ \text{cms}$.

How many men are there who are between $180$ and $190 \ \text{cms}$ tall? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the British Army there are $4500$ men who are taller than $180 \ \text{cms}$. 
Of these $750$ are taller than $190 \ \text{cms}$.
<emptyline>
How many men are there who are between $180$ and $190 \ \text{cms}$ tall? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Men between 180 and 190}         &= \text{Men taller than 180} - \text{Men taller than 190} \\\\
                                                 &= 4500 - 750 \\\\
                                                 &= 3750
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3750$
