<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jordan eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of a pizza and Anna eats $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of what is left.

Rohit, Guhesh and Matilda share equally the remainder.

What fraction of the pizza did Matilda eat? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jordan eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of a pizza and Anna eats $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of what is left.
<emptyline>
Rohit, Guhesh and Matilda share equally the remainder.
<emptyline>
What fraction of the pizza did Matilda eat? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Jordan ate}  &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
\text {Anna ate}    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \left(1 - \dfrac {1} {4} \right) \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3} {3 \times 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3} \times 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
\text {Pizza left}  &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {4} - \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
                    &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
\text {Matilda gets} &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {3 \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {6}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {6}$

</div>
</div>

                    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3} {3 \times 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3} \times 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
\text {Pizza left}  &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {4} - \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
                    &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\

                        &= \dfrac {1} {3 \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {6}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Grace plants a row of daffodils.

There is a gap of $1.1 \ \text {metres}$ within each daffodil, and the row begins and ends with a daffodil.

She has $8$ daffodils.

How long is the row of daffodils when she has finished? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Length of the row}   &= 7 \times 1.1 \\\\\
                            &= 7.7 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jerry the bearded dragon eats $12$ locusts for breakfast at the start of every day.

His owner buys $100$ locusts one afternoon for Jerry to eat.

How many locusts does Jerry get on the day these locusts run out? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jerry the bearded dragon eats $12$ locusts for breakfast at the start of every day.
<emptyline>
His owner buys $100$ locusts one afternoon for Jerry to eat.
<emptyline>
How many locusts does Jerry get on the day these locusts run out? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of days}       &= \dfrac {100} {12} \\\\
                            &= 8 \text{ remainder } 4
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of locusts on 9th day}                     &= 100 - 8 \times 12 \\\\
                                                        &= 100 - 96 \\\\
                                                        &= 4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ermintrude the female cat flea can lay $50$ eggs a day.

These become adults in $30 \ \text{days}$.

How many new adult fleas will there be in $40 \ \text{days}?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ermintrude the female cat flea can lay $50$ eggs a day.
<emptyline>
These become adults in $30 \ \text{days}$.
<emptyline>
How many new adult fleas will there be in $40 \ \text{days}?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Eggs take $30 \ \text{days}$ to become adults.
Therefore, only the eggs laid in the first $40 - 30 = 10 \ \text{days}$ will have time to become adults by the $40^{\text{th}}$ day.

Any eggs laid after day $10$ will not become adults until after day $40$.

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of productive days} &= 40 - 30 \\\\
&= 10 \ \text{days} \\\\
\text{Total new adult fleas} &= 10 \times 50 \\\\
&= 500
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$500$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A number is a multiple of $11$ if $11$ goes into it. $33$ and $121$ are both multiples of $11$.

Ajay says that a number is a multiple of $11$ if the difference of alternate sums of digits in the number is a multiple of $11$.

So, $27390628$ is a multiple of $11$ because

$2 + 3 + 0 + 2 = 8$

$7 + 9 + 6 + 8 = 30$

and $30 - 8 = 22$ which is a multiple of $11$. 

</div>

                                          &= 13
\end{aligned}
$

$13$ is not a multiple of $11$.

Therefore $978261$ is also not a multiple of $11$.

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find one of the ways to fill in the gaps so that this number is a multiple of $11$.

$\Large{7 \ \text{\textunderscore} \ 5  \ 6 \ \text{\textunderscore} \ 0}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find one of the ways to fill in the gaps so that this number is a multiple of $11$.
<emptyline>
$\Large{7 \ \text{\textunderscore} \ 5  \ 6 \ \text{\textunderscore} \ 0}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first gap $= a$ and the second gap $= b$

Number after filling the gaps $= 7a56b0$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sum of digits at odd position}      &= 7 + 5 + b \\\\
                                          &= 12 + b \\\\
\text{Sum of digits at even position}     &= a + 6 + 0 \\\\
                                          &= a + 6 \\\\
\text{Difference}                         &= 12 + b - (a + 6) \\\\
                                          &= 12 + b - a - 6 \\\\
                                          &= 6 + b - a
\end{aligned}
$

For a number to be a multiple of $11$, $6 + b - a$ must be a multiple of $11$ ($0$ or $11, -11, \ldots$).

An easy way to start is to try to make $6 + b - a$ equal to $0$ or $a = 6 + b$.

We can easily infer the values by using a trial and error table.

| $b$ |  $a$ |  $a$ is a digit (0–9)? |
| :--------------: | :--------------- | :-------------------: |
|        $0$       | $a = 6 + 0 = 6$      |          Yes          |
|        $1$       | $a = 6 + 1 = 7$      |          Yes          |
|        $2$       | $a = 6 + 2 = 8$      |          Yes          |
|        $3$       | $a = 6 + 3 = 9$      |          Yes          |
|        $4$       | $a = 6 + 4 = 10$     |           No          |

Possible answer $=765600$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$765600$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Krishn has $1 \ \text{hour}$ to clean the house before his parents get back from their holidays.

He has to hoover $3$ rooms, clean out his pet hamster's cage and wipe off the drawing of an elephant he accidently did on the bathroom wall.

Each room takes $12  \ \text{minutes}$ to hoover, it takes $18  \ \text{minutes}$ to clean out his hamster's cage and $21  \ \text{minutes}$ to rub out the elephant, which he does last.

Wht fraction of the elephant is left on the wall when Krishn's parents arrive home?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Krishn has $1 \ \text{hour}$ to clean the house before his parents get back from their holidays.
<emptyline>
He has to hoover $3$ rooms, clean out his pet hamster's cage and wipe off the drawing of an elephant he accidently did on the bathroom wall.
<emptyline>
Each room takes $12  \ \text{minutes}$ to hoover, it takes $18  \ \text{minutes}$ to clean out his hamster's cage and $21  \ \text{minutes}$ to rub out the elephant, which he does last.
<emptyline>
Wht fraction of the elephant is left on the wall when Krishn's parents arrive home?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken for rooms \& cage}       &= 12 \times 3 + 18 \\\\
                                                &= 36 + 18 \\\\
                                                &= 54 \ \text{min} \\\\
\text{Time left to wipe off elephant}       &= 60 - 54 \\\\
                                                &= 6 \ \text{min}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of elephant wiped off}           &= \dfrac {6} {21} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {7 \times 3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 3} {7 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
\text{Fraction of elephant left}                &= 1 - \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {1 \times 7} {1 \times 7} - \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {7 - 2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5} {7}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {5} {7}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$

                                                &= 36 + 18 \\\\
                                                &= 54 \ \text{min} \\\\
\text{Time left to wipe off elephant}       &= 60 - 54 \\\\
                                                &= 6 \ \text{min}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of elephant wiped off}           &= \dfrac {6} {21} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {7 \times 3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 3} {7 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
\text{Fraction of elephant left}                &= 1 - \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {1 \times 7} {1 \times 7} - \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {7 - 2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5} {7}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Complete the table to show what **percentage** of the cost of a cup of coffee goes to retailers, growers and others.

Show your working.

| Retailers     | $\%$         |
|:---------:    |---------:    |
|  Growers      | $\%$         |
|   Others      | $\%$         |

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Complete the table to show what **percentage** of the cost of a cup of coffee goes to retailers, growers and others.
<emptyline>
Show your working.
<emptyline>
| Retailers     | $\%$         |
|:---------:    |---------:    |
|  Growers      | $\%$         |
|   Others      | $\%$         |
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Retailers \%} &= \dfrac{5} {2.50 \times 100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 100 } {250} \\\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 50 \times 2} {5 \times 50} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times \cancel{50} \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel{50} } \\\\
                                                     &= 2 \% \\\\
\text{Growers \%}   &= \dfrac{30} {2.50 \times 100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{30 \times 100 } {250} \\\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 6 \times 50 \times 2} {5 \times 50} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 6 \times \cancel{50} \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel{50} } \\\\
                                                     &= 6 \times 2 \\\\
                                                     &= 12 \% \\\\
\text{Others \%}    &= \dfrac{2.15 \times 100} {2.50 \times 100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{215 \times 100 } {250} \\\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 43 \times 50 \times 2} {5 \times 50} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 43 \times \cancel{50} \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel{50} } \\\\
                                                     &= 43 \times 2 \\\\
                                                     &= 86 \% 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**


| Retailers     | $2 \%$       |
|:---------:    |---------:    |
|  Growers      | $12 \%$      |
|   Others      | $86 \%$      |

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A car hire firm charges $\pounds 35 \ \text{per day}$ plus $34 \ \text{p per km}$ travelled. A man hired a car for $4 \ \text{days}$ and travelled 
$300 \ \text{km}$. How much did he pay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A car hire firm charges $\pounds 35 \ \text{per day}$ plus $34 \ \text{p per km}$ travelled. A man hired a car for $4 \ \text{days}$ and travelled 
$300 \ \text{km}$. How much did he pay?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Amount he paid}                &= 4 \times \pounds 35 + 300 \times 34 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                      &= 4 \times \pounds 35 + 300 \times \pounds 0.34 \\\\
                                      &= 140 +  102 \\\\
                                      &= 140 +  102 \\\\
                                      &= \pounds 242
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 242$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Four lamp posts are in a straight line. The distance from each post to the next is $25 \ \text{m}$. 
What is the distance from the first post to the last?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Four lamp posts are in a straight line. The distance from each post to the next is $25 \ \text{m}$. 
What is the distance from the first post to the last?
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jeff goes to the cinema. He buys a ticket for $\pounds 5.75$, popcorn for $\pounds 1.50$ and a drink for $76 \ \text{p}$. 
His return train fare is $\pounds 3.80$. If he leaves home with a $\pounds 20$ note how much change does he return with?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jeff goes to the cinema. He buys a ticket for $\pounds 5.75$, popcorn for $\pounds 1.50$ and a drink for $76 \ \text{p}$. 
His return train fare is $\pounds 3.80$. If he leaves home with a $\pounds 20$ note how much change does he return with?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}         &= \pounds 5.75 + \pounds 1.50 + 76 \ \text{p} + \pounds 3.80 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 5.75 + \pounds 1.50 + \pounds 0.76 + \pounds 3.80 \\\\
                            &= 5.75 + 1.50 +  0.76 + 3.80\\\\
                            &= 11.81 \\\\
\text {Change received}     &= 20 - 11.81 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 8.19
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 8.19$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$\pounds 50000$ in $\pounds 50$ notes weighs about $1.3 \ \text{Kg}$. How much, in grams, does one $\pounds 50$ note weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\pounds 50000$ in $\pounds 50$ notes weighs about $1.3 \ \text{Kg}$. How much, in grams, does one $\pounds 50$ note weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of notes}      &= \dfrac {50000} {50} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {50 \times 1000} {50} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel{50} \times 1000} {\cancel{50}} \\\\
                            &= 1000 \\\\
\text{Weight of a note}     &= \dfrac {1.3} { 1000} \ \text{kg} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1.3 \times 1000} { 1000} \ \text {g} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1.3 \times 1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0} \cancel{0}} { 1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0} \cancel{0} } \\\\
                            &= 1.3 \ \text {g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1.3 \ \text {g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Subtract three times the smallest number from twice the largest number in this list:

$4, \quad 11,\quad 8, \quad 2, \quad 7, \quad 13$


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Subtract three times the smallest number from twice the largest number in this list:
<emptyline>
$4, \quad 11,\quad 8, \quad 2, \quad 7, \quad 13$
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Smallest number} &= 2 \\\\
\text{Largest number} &= 13 \\\\
\text{Difference} &= (2 \times 13) - (3 \times 2) \\\\
&= 26 - 6 \\\\
&= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Five friends shared the cost of a mansion (priced at $3$ million pounds) equally. How much did each of them pay ?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Five friends shared the cost of a mansion (priced at $3$ million pounds) equally. How much did each of them pay ?  
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 600000} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 600000} {\cancel{5}} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 600000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In an orchestra there are $60$ children. If $\dfrac {1} {5}$ play the recorder and $40\%$ play the triangle, how many children play something else?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In an orchestra there are $60$ children. If $\dfrac {1} {5}$ play the recorder and $40\%$ play the triangle, how many children play something else?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Children playing something else} &= \text{Total children - Playing recorder - Playing triangle}  \\\\
&= 60 - \dfrac {1} {5} \times 60 - 40\% \times 60 \\\\
&= 60 - \dfrac {60} {5} - \dfrac {40 \times 60} {100} \\\\
&= 60 - \dfrac {5 \times 12} {5} -  \dfrac {40 \times 60} {100} \\\\
&= 60 - \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 12} {\cancel{5}}  -\dfrac {4 \cancel{0} \times 6 \cancel{0}} {1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0}} \\\\
&= 60 - 12 - 24 \\\\
&= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alex and Emma buy the same type of bike.

Alex pays $\pounds169.99$ cash from his birthday money.

Emma pays a deposit of $\pounds70.00$ and then pays instalments of $\pounds10$ per month over the course of one year (12 months).

Who pays the most and by how much ? Show all of your working clearly.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alex and Emma buy the same type of bike.
<emptyline>

<emptyline>
Emma pays a deposit of $\pounds70.00$ and then pays instalments of $\pounds10$ per month over the course of one year (12 months).
<emptyline>
Who pays the most and by how much ? Show all of your working clearly.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount paid by Alex}                   &= \pounds 169.99 \\\\
\text{Amount paid by Emma}                   &= 70 + 12 \times 10 \\\\ 
                                                 &= 70 + 120 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 190 \\\\
\text{Difference}     &= 190 - 169.99 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 20.01
\end{aligned}
$

Emma pays $\pounds 20.01$ more than Alex
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Emma pays more

</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

\text{Minibuses needed} &= \dfrac {\text{Total members}} {\text{Seats per minibus}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {39} {15} \\\\
&= 2 \ \text{remainder } 9
\end{aligned}
$

We need $1$ more minibus for the remaining $9$ members.

Total minibuses $= 2 + 1 = 3$
</div>

**Question**

How many spare seats were there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many spare seats were there?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total seats available} &= \text{Minibuses} \times \text{Seats per minibus} \\\\
&= 3 \times 15 \\\\
&= 45 \\\\
\text{Spare seats} &= \text{Total seats available} - \text{Total members} \\\\
&= 45 - 39 \\\\
&= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The transport costs were $\pounds 90$ altogether. They also had to pay $\pounds 150$ for the group to use the leisure centre. Helen collected $\pounds 6.50$ from each passenger to pay for this.

How much was left over?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The transport costs were $\pounds 90$ altogether. They also had to pay $\pounds 150$ for the group to use the leisure centre. Helen collected $\pounds 6.50$ from each passenger to pay for this.
<emptyline>
How much was left over?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total costs} &= \text{Transport} + \text{Leisure centre} \\\\
&= 90 + 150 \\\\
&= \pounds 240 \\\\
\text{Total collected} &= 39 \times 6.50 \\\\
&= \pounds 253.50 \\\\
\text{Left over} &= \text{Total collected} - \text{Total costs} \\\\
&= 253.50 - 240 \\\\
&= \pounds 13.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 13.50$

</div>
</div>

                                  &= \pounds 17.40
\end{aligned}
$

  & \text{doughnuts}                  &:& \text{cost} \\\\
= & 1                                 &:& \pounds 1.45 \\\\
= & 1 \times 12                       &:& 1.45 \times 12 \\\\
= & 12                                &:& \pounds 17.40
\end{array}
$

Cost $= \pounds 17.40$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Pairs of avocados are sold in a shop. $16$ pairs of avocados are sold at a total cost of $\pounds 24$. The shopkeeper now decides to separate the pairs and sell the avocados individually, but without any change to the total price. What is the cost of an individual avocado? Give your answer in pence.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Pairs of avocados are sold in a shop. $16$ pairs of avocados are sold at a total cost of $\pounds 24$. The shopkeeper now decides to separate the pairs and sell the avocados individually, but without any change to the total price. What is the cost of an individual avocado? Give your answer in pence.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 pair of avocados}     &= \dfrac {\pounds  24} {16} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {24 \times 100 \ \text{pence}} {16}  \\\\
\text{Cost of 1 avocado}              &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {24 \times 100} {16} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {24 \times 100} {2 \times 16} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 2 \times 2 \times 25} {2 \times 8 \times 2} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {\cancel{8} \times 3 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{2} \times 25} {\cancel{2} \times \cancel{8} \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                                      &= 3 \times 25  \\\\
                                      &= 75 \ \text{pence}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$75 \ \text{pence}$

</div>
</div>

                                      &= \dfrac {24 \times 100 \ \text{pence}} {16}  \\\\

                                      &= \dfrac {24 \times 100} {2 \times 16} \\\\

**Question**

Marie bought seven cinema tickets for $\pounds 58.10$. How much was each ticket? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

                        &= \dfrac{7 \times 8.30 }{7} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{\cancel{7} \times 8.30 }{\cancel{7}} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 8.30
\end{aligned}
$

$\pounds 8.30$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mary, Jess and Jo run a race. 

Jess's time is $18 \ \text{seconds}$. 

Jo finishes $6 \ \text{seconds}$ before Jess. 

Mary finishes $4 \ \text{seconds}$ after Jo. 

What is **Mary's time** in seconds?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mary, Jess and Jo run a race. 
<emptyline>
Jess's time is $18 \ \text{seconds}$. 
<emptyline>
Jo finishes $6 \ \text{seconds}$ before Jess. 
<emptyline>
Mary finishes $4 \ \text{seconds}$ after Jo. 
<emptyline>
What is **Mary's time** in seconds?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Jess's time}  &= 18 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
\text {Jo's time}    &= 18 - 6 \\\\
                            &= 12 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
\text {Mary's time}  &= 12 + 4 \\\\
                            &= 16 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16 \ \text {seconds}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many bags of crisps at $16 \ \text{p}$ each can I buy for $\pounds 2 \text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many bags of crisps at $16 \ \text{p}$ each can I buy for $\pounds 2 \text{?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of crisp bags}    &= \dfrac {\text {Total money}} {\text {Money per bag}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\pounds 2} {16 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 100 \ \text{p}} {16 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {200} {16} \\\\
                                &= 12 \ \text {remainder} \ 8 \\\\
                                &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Benjamin walks dogs to earn some money. The formula below can be used to work out his pay.

$\text{Pay} = \pounds 12$ per day $+ \pounds 1.50$ for each dog walked

Benjamin worked all day on Monday. He walked $13$ dogs before lunch and $15$ dogs afterwards.

Work out Benjamin's pay on Monday.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Benjamin walks dogs to earn some money. The formula below can be used to work out his pay.
<emptyline>
$\text{Pay} = \pounds 12$ per day $+ \pounds 1.50$ for each dog walked
<emptyline>
Benjamin worked all day on Monday. He walked $13$ dogs before lunch and $15$ dogs afterwards.
<emptyline>
Work out Benjamin's pay on Monday.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{Total dogs walked} &= 13 + 15 \\\\
                         &= 28 \\\\
\text{Pay}               &= 12 + 1.50 \times 28 \\\\
                         &= 12 + 42 \\\\
                         &= \pounds 54
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{Total distance} &= 15 + 1170 + 15 \\\\
&= 1200 \ \text{m} \\\\
&= 1.2 \ \text{km}
\end{aligned}$
</div>

**Question**

If she walks at a speed of $8 \ \text{km/h}$, how long does it take her to get to school from home?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text {Distance} = \text{Speed} \times \text{Time}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text {Time taken}  &= \dfrac{1.2}{8} \ \text{hours} \\\\
&= \dfrac{1.2 \times 10}{8 \times 10} \ \text{hours} \\\\
&= \dfrac{12 \times 60}{8 \times 10} \ \text{minutes} \\\\
&= \dfrac{4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 3 \times 10}{4 \times 2 \times 10} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel{4} \times 3 \times \cancel{2} \times 3 \times \cancel{10}}{\cancel{4} \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{10}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 3 \\\\
&= 9 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Freya has $24$ badges. If she gives $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of them to her brother, how many does she have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Freya has $24$ badges. If she gives $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of them to her brother, how many does she have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If Freya gives $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of her badges away, then she is left with $1- \dfrac{3}{8} = \dfrac{5}{8}$ of badges.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Badges left}      &= \dfrac{5}{8} \times 24 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 24}{8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 3 \times 8}{8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 3 \times \cancel{8}}{\cancel{8}} \\\\
                        &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15$

</div>
</div>

- $1$
- $900$
- $1001$
- $9998$
- $9899$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                       &= 24

**Question**

Rob works $40 \ \text{hours}$ a week and earns $\pounds 440$. What is his hourly rate of pay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                            &= \dfrac {40 \times 11} {40} \\\\

                            &= \pounds 11
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A large crate holds twelve cartons of milk whereas a small crate holds only four cartons. 
I have five large crates and twenty small crates available. 
What is the smallest number of crates in total that I could use to store $110$ cartons of milk?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A large crate holds twelve cartons of milk whereas a small crate holds only four cartons. 
I have five large crates and twenty small crates available. 
What is the smallest number of crates in total that I could use to store $110$ cartons of milk?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

To find the smallest number of crates in total, we should use as many large crates as possible.

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Capacity of large crate} &= 12 \\\\
\text{Capacity of small crate} &= 4 \\\\
\text{Total cartons} &= 110 \\\\
\text{Max large crates available} &= 5 \\\\
\text{Cartons in large crates} &= 5 \times 12 \\\\
&= 60 \\\\
\text{Remaining cartons} &= 110 - 60 \\\\
&= 50 \\\\
\text{Small crates needed} &= \dfrac{50}{4} \\\\
&= 12 \ \text{remainder } 2 \\\\
&\approx 13
\end{aligned}$

We need $1$ more small crate for the remaining $2$ cartons.

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Total crates} &= 5 + 13 \\\\
&= 18
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$18$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Four friends, Alwyn, Bax, Coates and Delius have lunch together. Although each eats a differently priced snack, 
they share the bill equally. Yesterday, this resulted in Alwyn paying $\pounds 1$ less than the cost of his snack, 
Bax paying $\pounds 3$ more, Coates $\pounds 4$ less and Delius paid $\pounds 4$. 
What was the actual price of the snack that each friend ordered?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Four friends, Alwyn, Bax, Coates and Delius have lunch together. Although each eats a differently priced snack, 
they share the bill equally. Yesterday, this resulted in Alwyn paying $\pounds 1$ less than the cost of his snack, 
Bax paying $\pounds 3$ more, Coates $\pounds 4$ less and Delius paid $\pounds 4$. 
What was the actual price of the snack that each friend ordered?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

All four friends shared the bill equally. 

Delius paid $\pounds 4$. So, each friend paid $\pounds 4$.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Alwyn's snack cost}      &= 4 + 1 \\\\
                      &= \pounds 5 \\\\
\text{Bax's snack cost}        &= 4 - 3 \\\\
                      &= \pounds 1 \\\\
\text{Coates's snack cost}     &= 4 + 4 \\\\
                      &= \pounds 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Alwyn $=$ $\pounds 5$

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Bax $=$ $\pounds 1$

**Answer**

Coates $=$ $\pounds 8$

Delius $=$ $\pounds 4$

**Question**

If it takes $90 \ \text{minutes}$ for two identical towels to dry on a washing line, how long would three of these towels have taken to dry?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If it takes $90 \ \text{minutes}$ for two identical towels to dry on a washing line, how long would three of these towels have taken to dry?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The towels are identical and we assume there is enough space on the line.

The drying time does not depend on the number of towels if they can all hang freely.

So $3$ towels would still take $90 \ \text{minutes}$ to dry.

Answer $= 90 \ \text{minutes}$
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the winter, I try and climb up an icy slope starting at the bottom. Each time 
I make a move I find that I go up four metres but then slide back down two metres. 
How many moves do I need to get to the top which is $8 \ \text{metres}$ up the slope from the bottom?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the winter, I try and climb up an icy slope starting at the bottom. Each time 
I make a move I find that I go up four metres but then slide back down two metres. 
How many moves do I need to get to the top which is $8 \ \text{metres}$ up the slope from the bottom?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Move 1 before sliding} &= 4 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{After sliding} &= 4 - 2  \\\\
                            &= 2 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Move 2 before sliding} &= 2 + 4 \ \text{m} \\\\
&= 6 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{After sliding} &= 6 - 2  \\\\
                            &= 4 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Move 3} &= 4 + 4 \\\\
                            &= 8 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}$

Number of moves $= 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The area of mould growing on my bathroom wall doubles every day. After $13$ days the area covered is $2880 \ \text{cm}^2$. 
After how days did the area first exceed $300 \ \text{cm}^2?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The area of mould growing on my bathroom wall doubles every day. After $13$ days the area covered is $2880 \ \text{cm}^2$. 
After how days did the area first exceed $300 \ \text{cm}^2?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's work backwards to find the area on previous days.

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Area after 13 days} &= 2880  \\\\
\text{Area after 12 days} &= \dfrac{2880}{2} \\\\
                          &= 1440 \ \text{cm}^2 \\\\
\text{Area after 11 days} &= \dfrac{1440}{2} \\\\
                          &= 720 \ \text{cm}^2 \\\\
\text{Area after 10 days} &= \dfrac{720}{2} \\\\
                          &= 360 \ \text{cm}^2 \\\\
\text{Area after 9 days} &= \dfrac{360}{2} \\\\
                         &= 180 \ \text{cm}^2
\end{aligned}$

The area first exceeds $300 \ \text{cm}^2$ after 10 days.

Answer $= 10$ days
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

An aircraft takes off from London Heathrow with $120000 \ \text{litres}$ of fuel on board. 
It flies at an average speed of $800 \ \text{kilometres}$ per hour and uses fuel at a rate of $10 \ \text{litres}$ per kilometre.

How much fuel is left in the tank when it lands in Miami $9 \ \text{hours}$ later?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An aircraft takes off from London Heathrow with $120000 \ \text{litres}$ of fuel on board. 
It flies at an average speed of $800 \ \text{kilometres}$ per hour and uses fuel at a rate of $10 \ \text{litres}$ per kilometre.
<emptyline>
How much fuel is left in the tank when it lands in Miami $9 \ \text{hours}$ later?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Distance}                    &= 800 \times 9 \\\\
                                    &= 7200 \ \text{kilometres} \\\\
\text{Fuel used}                    &= 7200 \times 10 \\\\
                                    &= 72000 \ \text{litres} \\\\
\text{Fuel left}                    &= 120000 - 72000 \\\\
                                    &= 48000 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$48000 \ \text{litres}$

</div>

\end{aligned}

**Question**

Rinesh started painting his house two years ago. During that year, Rinesh painted one-third of his house.

Last year, Rinesh painted another five-twelfths of his house.

What fraction of his house does Rinesh need to paint this year, in order to finish completely painting his house?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Rinesh started painting his house two years ago. During that year, Rinesh painted one-third of his house.
<emptyline>
Last year, Rinesh painted another five-twelfths of his house.
<emptyline>
What fraction of his house does Rinesh need to paint this year, in order to finish completely painting his house?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction painted so far} &= \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{5}{12} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{1 \times 4}{3 \times 4} + \dfrac{5}{12} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{4}{12} + \dfrac{5}{12} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{9}{12} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{3 \times 3}{3 \times 4} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{\cancel{3} \times 3}{\cancel{3} \times 4} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{3}{4} \\\\
\text{Fraction needed}         &= 1 - \dfrac{3}{4} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{4}{4} - \dfrac{3}{4} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{1}{4}$

</div>

Bijal started weeding her garden two weeks ago. During that week, she weeded one-fifth of her garden.

Last week, Bijal weeded two and a half times as much of her garden as she weeded two weeks ago.

What fraction of her garden does Bijal need to weed this week, in order to finish completely weeding her garden?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bijal started weeding her garden two weeks ago. During that week, she weeded one-fifth of her garden.
<emptyline>
Last week, Bijal weeded two and a half times as much of her garden as she weeded two weeks ago.
<emptyline>
What fraction of her garden does Bijal need to weed this week, in order to finish completely weeding her garden?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Weeded two weeks ago} &= \dfrac{1}{5} \\\\
\text{Weeded last week}     &= 2.5 \times \dfrac{1}{5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5}{2} \times \dfrac{1}{5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{\cancel{5} \times 1}{2 \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
\text{Total weeded}         &= \dfrac{1}{5} + \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{2}{5 \times 2} + \dfrac{5}{2 \times 5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{2}{10} + \dfrac{5}{10} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
\text{Fraction needed}      &= 1 - \dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{10}{10} - \dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{3}{10} \\\\
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{3}{10}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Nina is painting garden gnomes. She has four-fifths of a litre of paint. Each garden gnome needs one-twentieth of a litre of paint. How many garden gnomes can she paint?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Nina is painting garden gnomes. She has four-fifths of a litre of paint. Each garden gnome needs one-twentieth of a litre of paint. How many garden gnomes can she paint?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of gnomes} &= \dfrac{4}{5} \div \dfrac{1}{20} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{4}{5} \times \dfrac{20}{1} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{4 \times 20}{5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{4 \times 4 \times 5}{5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{4 \times 4 \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
                        &= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many grams of ingredients other than lemons, flour and sugar are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many grams of ingredients other than lemons, flour and sugar are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount of sugar}  &= 225 \ \text{grams} \\\\
\text{Amount of flour}  &= \dfrac{1}{2} \times 900 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{900}{2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{450 \times 2}{2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{450 \times \cancel{2}}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
                        &= 450 \ \text{grams} \\\\
\text{Amount of lemons} &= \dfrac{1}{12} \times 900 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{900}{12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{75 \times 12}{12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{75 \times \cancel{12}}{\cancel{12}} \\\\
                        &= 75 \ \text{grams} \\\\\
\text{Others}  &= 900 - 225 - 450 - 75 \\\\
                        &= 150 \ \text{grams}
\end{aligned}$ 
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$150 \text{ gm}$ 

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the last year a library bought $237$ new books and removed $67$ books. 

There were $5745$ books in the library at the end of the year.

How many books were in the library at the start of the year?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the last year a library bought $237$ new books and removed $67$ books. 
<emptyline>
There were $5745$ books in the library at the end of the year.
<emptyline>
How many books were in the library at the start of the year?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Book at start of the year} &= 5745 - 237 + 67 \\\\
												&= 5575 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5575$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A chocolate bar costs $36 \ \text{p}$. How many can Nikita buy for $\pounds 3.00?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A chocolate bar costs $36 \ \text{p}$. How many can Nikita buy for $\pounds 3.00?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of chocolates}        &= \dfrac {\pounds 3} {36 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {3 \times 100 \ \text{p}} {36 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {300} {36} \\\\
                                    &= 8 \text{ remainder } 12 \\\\
                                    &\approx 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box contains $48$ pieces of fruit. Five eighths of them are apples and the rest of them are pears. How many pears are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box contains $48$ pieces of fruit. Five eighths of them are apples and the rest of them are pears. How many pears are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of apples} &= \dfrac {5} {8} \times 48 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 48} {8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 6 \times 8} {8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 6 \times \cancel {8}} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
                        &= 5 \times 6 \\\\
                        &= 30
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pears}  &= 48 - 30 \\\\
                        &= 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$18$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the largest number of balloons she can hang with a $4 \ \text{metre}$ ball of string?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the largest number of balloons she can hang with a $4 \ \text{metre}$ ball of string?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the largest number of balloons $= a$

Lets convert all the lengths into cm.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of balloons} 	&= \dfrac{\text{Total string}}{\text{String per balloon}} \\\\
                       		&= \dfrac{4 \ \text{m}}{35 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                       		&= \dfrac{400 \ \text{cm}}{35 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
							&= \dfrac{400}{35} \\\\
							&= 11 \ \text{ remainder } 15 \\\\
							&= 11
\end{aligned}
$

Largest number of balloons $= 11$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

He is paid $\pounds 3.60$ per hour. How much does he earn in one week?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">He is paid $\pounds 3.60$ per hour. How much does he earn in one week?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total hours} &= \dfrac{330}{60} \\\\
\text{Total earnings} &= 3.6 \times \dfrac{330}{60} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac{3.6 \times 330}{60} \\\\
				   &= \dfrac{36 \times 33}{6 \times 10} \\\\
				   &= \dfrac{6 \times 6 \times 33}{6 \times 10} \\\\
					&= \dfrac{\cancel{6} \times 6 \times 33}{\cancel{6} \times 10} \\\\
					&= \dfrac{6 \times 33}{10} \\\\
					  &= \pounds 19.80
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 19.80$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mr. and Mrs. Green and their four children went on a 
holiday. The accomodation costs $\pounds 320$ per 
adult and $\pounds 220$ per child. The travelling expenses
were $\pounds 222$ per adult and $\pounds 168$ per child. 

How much did their total holiday cost in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mr. and Mrs. Green and their four children went on a 
holiday. The accomodation costs $\pounds 320$ per 
adult and $\pounds 220$ per child. The travelling expenses
were $\pounds 222$ per adult and $\pounds 168$ per child. 
<emptyline>
How much did their total holiday cost in total?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
